explanation: Wikipedia's 'Littlewood conjecture' page attributes Hausdorff dimension zero of the exceptional set to Einsiedler-Kleinbock. The Lean liminf cannot hit Lean's junk value, since at q=p^k the expression is ‖p^kξ‖≤1/2, so the sequence does not tend to infinity. liminf≠0 is the exceptional set for irrational ξ; rational ξ give 0. Faithful.
